statements.text: The slotted text is the accessible name. For an icon-only button set the ariaLabel property in script (it has no attribute; an aria-label on the host is not forwarded), or use violet-icon-button.

aria-labelledby, aria-describedby, aria-errormessage and aria-controls name ids in the host's tree; the inner button gets those elements, found when set and on connect. aria-description and aria-keyshortcuts are forwarded.

attributes.description: Visual emphasis variant for the button. `quiet` and `transparent` render the same, as text until the pointer is on it; `transparent` is kept for existing markup.
attributes.name: appearance

attributes.description: Ids of the elements the button controls, in the host's tree, forwarded as element references.
attributes.name: aria-controls

attributes.description: Ids of the elements that describe the button, in the host's tree, forwarded as element references.
attributes.name: aria-describedby

attributes.description: Plain-text description forwarded to the inner button.
attributes.name: aria-description

attributes.description: Id of the element holding the button's error message, in the host's tree, forwarded as an element reference.
attributes.name: aria-errormessage

attributes.description: Optional expanded state forwarded to the inner button.
attributes.name: aria-expanded

attributes.description: Optional popup type forwarded to the inner button.
attributes.name: aria-haspopup

attributes.description: Optional keyboard shortcut description forwarded to the inner button.
attributes.name: aria-keyshortcuts

attributes.description: Ids of the elements that label the button, in the host's tree. The inner button gets them as element references, because ids do not resolve across a shadow root.
attributes.name: aria-labelledby

attributes.description: Optional pressed state ("true", "false" or "mixed") forwarded to the inner button for toggle buttons.
attributes.name: aria-pressed

attributes.description: Native button type forwarded to the internal control.
attributes.name: type

slots.description: Trailing inline content such as a status glyph.
slots.name: after

slots.description: Leading inline content such as an icon.
slots.name: before

summary: Text button for actions, with before and after slots for icons; also the trigger for menus, disclosures and toggle buttons.

usage.text: Not form-associated: type="submit" or "reset" is copied to a button inside the shadow root and does not submit or reset an enclosing form. Call form.requestSubmit() from a click listener.
aria-expanded, aria-controls, aria-haspopup and aria-pressed set on the host (or the matching properties) reach the inner button. Use them for disclosure, menu and toggle buttons.
Put a leading icon in the before slot and a trailing one in the after slot; mark a violet-icon there decorative when the text already says what the button does.

The default appearance is primary, so in a row of buttons set secondary or quiet on all but the main action, and danger on a destructive one. Transparent renders exactly as quiet and is kept for existing markup; write quiet.
